plainTranslation: Composite Mars square Saturn: drive grinds against limits; effort meets resistance, stop-and-go. Work: channel it into steady building; don't force or stall.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
